WITH date_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002)
),
store_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk AS s_store_sk
    FROM store
    WHERE s_county = 'Williamson County'
),
household_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk AS hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND CASE WHEN hd_vehicle_count > 0 THEN hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count ELSE NULL END > 1
)
SELECT c.c_last_name AS c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name AS c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation AS c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag AS c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt AS cnt
FROM (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number AS ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk AS ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales ss
    INNER JOIN date_keys dk ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dk.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN store_keys sk ON ss.ss_store_sk = sk.s_store_sk
    INNER JOIN household_keys hk ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hk.hd_demo_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
    HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
) dj
INNER JOIN customer c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
